# RC63 — Terminal PTY Probe

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/wscrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc t P` / `task.terminal-probe` / Terminal PTY Probe.
- Added `:terminal-probe`, `:term-probe`, `:shell-probe`, and `:pty-probe` aliases.
- Wired a fixed, bounded shell snapshot through the embedded PTY backend into the read-only Terminal Panel.
- The probe runs in the workspace root, sets `WSCRPT_WORKSPACE` to that root, and reports `stty size` from the allocated PTY.
- The probe retains at most 8 KiB in memory, accepts no user-supplied shell text, and does not persist probe output into session state.
- Added PTY environment injection so callers can pass explicit environment pairs into spawned PTY processes.
- Kept the live-terminal claim scoped: arbitrary shell input/pane I/O is still not attached; `Esc t t` remains the full-screen shell handoff.

## Open gate

- No real iPad/Blink/mosh/hardware feel approval is claimed. `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md` remains the hardware release gate.
- Live UI-attached arbitrary terminal pane I/O is not claimed. `Esc t P` is a fixed one-shot PTY probe into the Terminal Panel; `Esc t p` is still a read-only panel; `Esc t t` is still a full-screen shell handoff.
- Clipboard success, Escape delivery, modifier mappings, resize behavior, reconnect behavior, and touch/trackpad feel require real Blink/iPad validation.
